evidence.paragraph: Fourth quarter GAAP diluted EPS of $2.30 increased from $1.30 in the prior year. Adjusted EPS of $1.09 decreased from $1.19 in the prior year, primarily due to a decline in adjusted operating income in the Health Care Benefits segment, reflecting changes in the seasonality of the Medicare Part D program due to the impact of the Inflation Reduction Act (“IRA”).

Net Income and Diluted Net Income Per Share: GAAP net income was $267.3 million, or $0.68 per diluted share, for the fourth quarter of 2025, compared to GAAP net income of $151.7 million, or $0.38 per diluted share, for the fourth quarter of 2024.
